risks.title: Cyberattacks or data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly overseen by the Technology and Operations Committee, with quarterly reporting to the board. The language emphasizes the significance of cyber threats, the presence of a CISO with over 20 years of experience, and incident response plans. Cybersecurity is a critical category for a financial IT company.

risks.title: Dependence on critical technologies
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on integrated technology platforms for execution, clearing, and compliance. Any system failure could significantly impact services. Implicitly mentioned through global infrastructure and digital platforms. Technology category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Risks related to recent acquisitions of RJO and Benchmark
risks.score_rationale: Two major acquisitions (RJO and Benchmark) completed on July 31, 2025, with integration ongoing. Explicit mention of expected synergies and integration complexity. Debt financing (625M$ Senior Secured Notes) increases financial risk. Capital category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Increased competition in financial services
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements: impact of growing competition on future results. Risk of competitive pressure from large banking institutions. Competition category moderately to highly weighted.

risks.title: Changing financial regulations
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements: impact of government regulatory changes. Company operates in a highly regulated sector (financial markets, clearing, foreign exchange). Risk of non-compliance or increased costs. Regulation category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Trade tariffs and macroeconomic instability
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk related to new or changing tariffs. Mention of multiple structural and geopolitical factors (global conflicts, inflation, market volatility, supply chain constraints). Potential impacts: reduced trading volumes, higher operating expenses, logistical issues observed in precious metals.

risks.title: Counterparty losses and trading activities risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements regarding risks of losses from counterparty defaults in market-making and trading activities. Inherent risk in global financial services.
